public_rationale: The supplement documents substantial custom data construction and a deliberately organized system of filters and strategic-planning procedures. That supports the claim about hand-crafted structure and task customization. Its classical-AI analogy is supportable in the limited sense Marcus explicitly states. Some examples were generated automatically by learned models, so the evidence does not support reading hand-crafting as manual authorship of all data or as an absence of deep learning.
limitations: Quite heavily is assessed through substantive design choices, not a measured percentage of effort or performance.
The classical-AI comparison applies to customization and structure, not to a formal classification of the whole system.
The evidence does not quantify the prevailing Zeitgeist.

criteria.contradiction_condition: The methods show little consequential task-specific data engineering or architectural customization, with the claimed structure instead learned through a largely generic training procedure.
